name: Pinbar entry with TP/SL as multiples of pinbar size
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Bullish pinbar: close and open both in the lowest 30% of the bar range with bullish wick geometry (isBullishPinbar helper); enter long (shorts optional via mirrored isBearishPinbar).
exit: Take profit = entry + profitMultiplier x pinbar size; stop = pinbar low x (1 - target loss %); optional trailing (trail_price).
take_profit: X times pinbar size above entry
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Multiplier defaults and trailing branch need code read.
